profile.name: 汉密尔顿自动化液体处理工作站
profile.description: 汉密尔顿自动化液体处理工作站是一类用于实验室自动化移液、分液和样品制备的台式仪器，常见于高通量实验流程。它通常配备移液通道、机械运动平台以及用于板、管等耗材处理的模块，可用于试剂分装、样品转移和标准化液体处理任务。
profile.description_en: A Hamilton automated liquid handling workstation is a benchtop laboratory instrument used for automated pipetting, dispensing, and sample preparation in high-throughput workflows. It typically combines pipetting channels, a robotic motion system, and modules for handling plates, tubes, and other labware, and is used for reagent distribution, sample transfer, and standardized liquid handling tasks.
